_about: The name rule both editions share (name_violation in textfmt.py / textfmt.rs), on every code point: runs [first, last, what] in hexadecimal, in order, covering U+0000..U+10FFFF, where what is the description name_violation gives a name made of that one character, less its ' U+XXXX', or null when that name is accepted. Only the Python edition can hold a surrogate; the Rust edition checks that it cannot. Written from the Python edition by 'PYTHONPATH=py python3 py/tests/test_herdr_run_golden.py --write-name-verdicts'; both unit-test suites check every code point against it.
